description: This file defines the CommandQueue class, responsible for managing a queue of commands in a serial communication context, including sending commands, handling confirmations, retries, and timing. It functions as a singleton and contains logic to ensure commands are acknowledged before considering them completed.

classes.name: CommandQueue
classes.description: Singleton class managing command transmission, confirmations, retries, and event notifications in a serial communication setup.

classes.name: CommandQueue.MethodInvocation
classes.description: Inner class representing a command invocation, including command string, timeout, and listener for confirmation.

classes.name: CommandQueue.CommandQueueListener
classes.description: Interface for classes that want to listen to command events.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CommandQueue.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified of command events.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overloaded methods to enqueue commands with optional timeout, listener, and event firing.

methods.name: handleConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Processes a confirmation message received from the serial interface, updates pending confirmations, and notifies waiting threads.
